module: Yaw control component acting on electronically controlled front/rear differentials (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 70). It registers with tractionControl (order 20, no action) and yawControl (order 10). When the vehicle oversteers under acceleration, it sets overrideMin/overrideMax of the differential controllers (activeDiffLock or electronicDiffLock) to lock or open the differential according to the body slip angle.
notes: jbeam keys: frontDiffName (default "lockFront") and rearDiffName (default "lockRear") = differential controller names; slip angle thresholds (rad) openFrontDiffOversteerThresholdMin/Max (0/0), openRearDiffOversteerThresholdMin/Max (0/0.1), lockableFrontDiffOversteerThresholdMin/Max (0/0.2), lockableRearDiffOversteerThresholdMin/Max (0/0.2).

The differential controller type (typeName field) determines the method: "drivingDynamics/actuators/activeDiffLock" (lockable differential) or "drivingDynamics/actuators/electronicDiffLock" (open differential). Any other type = nop. If neither differential exists, the component neutralizes itself (actAs... = nop).
actAsYawControl always returns false so as not to trigger the ESC light; the real state is in isActingAsYC. It only reacts if electrics.values.throttle > 0.
The internal functions yawControlBiasFrontDiff/yawControlBiasRearDiff are defined but never used.
The open front differential has no effect (max override set to 1, "TODO" in the code).
The tractionControl.isEnabled parameters are declared in controlParameters but setParameters does not process them (only the yawControl branch is applied).

isActingAsYC.desc: True when a differential is currently forced.

initSecondStage.desc: Looks for the differential controllers, registers with the supervisors and reads the thresholds.

updateGFX.desc: Empty (debug version: sends a state packet).

actAsTractionControl.desc: Called by tractionControl; does nothing and returns false.

actAsYawControl.desc: Called by yawControl: resets the overrides to zero then, in case of oversteer under acceleration, applies the front/rear control methods.

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU.

setParameters.desc: Applies the yawControl.* parameters (isEnabled and the eight thresholds) via CMU.applyParameter.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU (debug packet).
